notes.title: Garage Flipper released!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Flippers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]Are you ready for some exciting transformations? You better be because Garage Flipper full version has just been released on Steam! 🤩[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1764270/Garage_Flipper/

[h3]Grow your business, upgrade your tools and pick up better, more demanding contracts as you become increasingly famous in the flipper community! 💪[/h3]

[previewyoutube=6jF-rwm1BUs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]If you have your eyes on our other games click the banner below and take a look at the bundles we’ve prepared for you! 👇[/b][/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1764270/view/4658502078446466633][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44660299/1cfe346d527414ca658356b26b69d34aef76e271.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: PLAY NOW FOR FREE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]It is Time to Renovate the Garage in the free Prologue! ⚒️[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414010/Garage_Flipper_Prologue/

[h3]We are extremely happy that you can now play the free Prologue of Garage Flipper, this is another extremely important stage in the development of our game. 😊[/h3]

[h3]If you want to be a part of the game development of Garage Flipper, we encourage you to share your ideas, suggestions, opinions or leave your feedback. 🤝[/h3]

[previewyoutube=MICklslXZRw;full][/previewyoutube]
Garage Flipper: Prologue is just a part of the full version of Garage Flipper. Prologue is available in 12 languages - English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and Turkish.


[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2414010/discussions/0/4038103329142985696/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44660299/9614bc31701386ffc8afa4d03d094fbd03a53d19.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2414010/discussions/0/4038103329142984803/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44660299/c7fada180728fd4e21586652ca79835d5636b942.png[/img][/url]


[h3][b]You can also chat with us and other community members on Discord! 👇[/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/9s9TEWZMkP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]


[h3][b]Remember to Wishlist the Full Version of the game to be up to date with all the news! [/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1764270/Garage_Flipper/

Have fun!
Garage Flipper Team

notes.title: Release Date Set!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 🙌[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Prologue Launching This Week! 👨‍🔧[/b][/h2]

[h3]We are very pleased to inform you that the free Prologue of Garage Flipper will be available to play this week! 🥳[/h3]

[h1][b] 🧰 Prologue premiere: December 8, 2023; 2:00 PM CET! 🧰[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414010/Garage_Flipper_Prologue/

[previewyoutube=9hXtuRKj0tU;full][/previewyoutube]

We have collected enough feedback from you and we are ready for the premiere of the free Prologue. 🤝

[h3][b]So book your date for [u]December 8, 2023, at 2:00 PM CET[/u]. and get your hands dirty, we have a garage to flip! 😎[/b][/h3]

[h3]If you have any questions about Prologue, feel free to jump on the Discord server where you can talk directly with our team 👇[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/9s9TEWZMkP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281894/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Garage Flipper Team
